answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 14602 Country: India Title: If adahn is going on ,is it correct to do abluation, going to toilet or any other act or we have to wtill adhan is complete? Question: If adahn is going on ,is it correct to do abluation, going to toilet or any other act or we have to wtill adhan is complete? Answer ID: 14602 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1139/1139=M/1430) If there is no urgent need one should not engage himself in anything until the azan completes, but he should respond the azan: وینبغي للسامع أن لایتکلم ولایشتغل بشئ في حالۃ الأذان والإقامۃ ولایرد السلام لأن الکل یخل بالنظم (الشامي) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
